question: What is the standard height of a volleyball net from the ground for the men's team?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2.43 metres**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Volleyball:

__
 
• Volleyball is a team sport.
 
• It is played between two teams of six players.
 
• Teams are separated by a net.
 
• Each team tries to score points by grounding a ball on the other team's court under organised rules.

Explanation:__

Fundamental skills of volleyball:

 
• Passing,
 
• serving,
 
• setting,
 
• spiking/smashing,
 
• blocking and
 
• digging

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Dimensions:

 
• The dimension of the court is18m/9m.
 
• The width of the net is 1m.
 
• The height of the net is 2.43m for men and 2.24m for women.
 
• A 3 m line in each court is marked to determine the front court and back court.
 
• A regulation volleyball should be 65-67 centimeters in circumference and weigh 260-280 grams.
